subject.title: fix(ci): verify stale bugs before closure

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this prevention-first policy: every live `bug`-labeled issue is exempt from Barnacle inactivity closure and enters the capped ClawSweeper verification lane when it becomes stale?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but it deliberately changes repository-wide issue-resolution policy and operational review volume; that acceptance cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve bounded verification rollout
options.body: Adopt the exact-label, fixed-actor, capped lane and require controlled event proof before merging.

options.title: Keep existing stale policy
options.body: Do not exempt all bug-labeled issues until maintainers choose a different resolution-policy design.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded verification rollout
recommendation.body: Adopt the exact-label, fixed-actor, capped lane and require controlled event proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked design and implementation and are the clearest available owner for the policy boundary.
